decisions.reason: As a broader dietary-supplement range closely aligned with the firm's consumer-health expansion, a product line that has survived beyond launch is more likely to be retained than discontinued.

This pharmacy-oriented skin and hair supplement fits the firm's OTC and dietary-supplement portfolio, but as a more targeted lifestyle product it is somewhat more exposed to portfolio rationalization.
The mushroom-based immune supplement remains a niche and less prominently marketed product, so even though it fits the health-product portfolio its discontinuation risk is materially higher.

The OTC migraine triptan supports the firm's broadening into higher-value consumer medicines, but its greater distance from the earlier supplement launches and likely stronger competitive pressure make it the most at risk among the products kept.
